name: evidence-v2
goal: Each story gives concrete, observable evidence for at least one world condition
problem: Evidence atoms for environment, resources and housing: is each one clear to Clef and learnable on CPU
note: Two paraphrases (a, b) and one reversed question per atom. Written before any answers were seen.

probes.a: Does {file} report a water shortage, drought restriction or contaminated water supply?
probes.b: Does {file} say people lack safe or enough water, or that water is rationed or polluted?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report a water shortage ending or a water supply being made safe again?

probes.a: Does {file} report farmland, forest or soil being lost to erosion, fire, flooding or building?
probes.b: Does {file} describe land being degraded, deforested or swallowed by development?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report land, forest or soil being restored or protected?

probes.a: Does {file} report a decline in wildlife, species, habitats or fish stocks?
probes.b: Does {file} describe animals, plants or fish disappearing or their habitats being destroyed?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report wildlife, species or habitats recovering?

probes.a: Does {file} report extreme heat, drought, flooding, wildfire or a severe storm?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a weather disaster or record temperatures hitting a place?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report a weather threat passing or easing?

probes.a: Does {file} report air pollution, smog or harmful emissions getting worse?
probes.b: Does {file} describe dirty air, smoke or toxic gases affecting people?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report air quality improving or emissions falling?

probes.a: Does {file} report metals, minerals or raw materials becoming scarcer or more expensive?
probes.b: Does {file} describe shortages or export limits on materials such as chips, rare earths, copper or lithium?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report metals or raw materials becoming cheaper or easier to get?

probes.a: Does {file} report people going hungry or unable to afford enough food?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a famine, food shortage, food bank demand or food prices people cannot meet?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report hunger easing or food becoming easier to get?

probes.a: Does {file} report rents, house prices or mortgage costs going up?
probes.b: Does {file} say homes are becoming less affordable for people to rent or buy?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report rents, house prices or mortgage costs going down?

probes.a: Does {file} report roads, bridges, power grids, pipes or public buildings damaged, failing or decaying?
probes.b: Does {file} describe infrastructure breaking down, collapsing or in need of urgent repair?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report infrastructure being built, repaired or upgraded?

decisions: Where does the story in {file} mainly take place or matter?
How much does the story in {file} change ordinary people's lives?
